title: scrumia-web-audience — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-web-audience: audience measurement kept inside the consent exemption — a closed event catalogue, one module owning the tracker, cleaned addresses, an opt-out that lasts.
tagline: Measure the audience, stay inside the exemption.
responsibilities: Five refusal rules and a checklist: events come from a closed catalogue; one module owns the tracker and pages declare events by attribute; the address sent is the path template; nothing is measured outside production or against a browser signal; the opt-out sits in the privacy policy and outlasts the measurement cookie. The checklist turns the exemption conditions into fifteen closed questions. Ships a web-audience-audit skill and a detector that lists files outside the module that touch the tracker queue — a text search, so an aliased call is not found.
refusals: An event the specification does not list. A page that calls the tracker itself. A query string, a fragment or a code in a path sent to the measurement. A measurement outside production. An opt-out shorter-lived than the cookie it refuses. Campaign attribution presented as exempt.
philosophy: Assumes the measurement is exempt as a whole or not at all, so every addition is checked against the conditions before it ships. The checklist paraphrases the French authority and says its current text prevails; a project under another authority keeps the structure and swaps the checklist. Costs a specification change per new event, and pays back in a privacy policy that stays true.
